title: Additional steps required to fix SSSD CVE-2025-11561 | SUSE | Support Center
plain_text:
Additional steps required to fix SSSD CVE-2025-11561
Environment
Help Environment

For a comprehensive list of affected products please review the SUSE Security Announcement for CVE-2025-11561.

Situation

A vulnerability, assigned the ID of CVE-2025-11561, was discovered in the sssd software.

The Kerberos local authentication plugin (sssd_krb5_localauth_plugin) is not enabled by default in SSSD configuration. 
Because of this, when integration of Active Directory and the System Security Services Daemon (SSSD) happens on Linux systems, it is possible for users with permission to modify certain AD attributes to impersonate privileged users and gain access to unauthorized resources on domain-joined Linux hosts.

To avoid problems relating to this vulnerability, SUSE has enabled the Kerberos local authentication plugin by default in
/etc/krb5.conf.d, and explicitly disabled the insecure Kerberos an2ln module:

[plugins]
    localauth = {
        disable = an2ln
        module = sssd:/usr/lib64/sssd/modules/sssd_krb5_localauth_plugin.so
 }
Resolution

Even with the adjustment made to /etc/krb5.conf.d, system updates will not automatically patch vulnerable systems where /etc/krb5.conf was modified in order to disable use of the plugin. To ensure protection against attacks that target the vulnerability, please confirm that the Kerberos local authentication plugin is also properly enabled in the /etc/krb5.conf file.

Cause
Additional Information
